title: Instruction phases for a register move
statement: Let $E$ be a natural number, let $s$ and $d$ be registers among 18 registers, let $x$ be an exit label, let $m$ assign a label to each of three phases, and let $j$ be one of those phases. The instruction at phase $j$ is a zero test on register $s$, branching to $x$ if it is zero and to phase $1$ otherwise when $j=0$; it decrements $s$ and continues to phase $2$ when $j=1$; and in the remaining phase it increments $d$ and returns to phase $0$.
hypotheses_covered: Source and destination are registers among 18 registers
A label is assigned to each of three phases
The phase index is in the three-element set
